testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient or HCP.

step.actions: patient: A patient can add daily blood sugar entries , upload a CSV containing blood sugar data , or view their blood sugar data . An HCP can search for and view the blood sugar data for any patient , as well as update that patient's upper blood sugar limits .
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
